official_documentation.title: How can I best use the Advanced search?
official_documentation.claim_summary: Describes Advanced Search fields and Boolean/proximity use; says proximity operators find words near or within a specified distance and says no explicit query-length limit is stated.

official_documentation.title: Search Tips: What makes a Scopus search complex?
official_documentation.claim_summary: Defines W/n and PRE/n as AND within or preceding by a specified distance; warns that proximity distance increases search complexity. It does not state whether n counts endpoints, token positions, or intervening lexical tokens.

w_n_semantics.protocol_target: unordered pair in the same field with no more than five intervening lexical tokens
w_n_semantics.observed_source_syntax: W/6 accepted in pair-bearing Scopus cells
w_n_semantics.reason: Neither current official page accessed states the endpoint/intervening-token counting convention, and the scoped P01 zero syntax diagnostic cannot decide it.
w_n_semantics.implementation_assessment: W/6 is a documented conservative same-field fallback: it cannot lose a protocol pair under either common distance convention. If Scopus n counts intervening tokens it can additionally admit a six-intervening-token pair; if it counts endpoint span/positions it can be exact. Exact equivalence is not claimed.
w_n_semantics.disposition: Retain W/6 unchanged as a lossless, potentially one-token-broader implementation and report the limitation for human review.

controlled_vocabulary.observed_ui: P01 observed a distinct INDEXTERMS field and one legally accessed record with separate indexed-term sections, but no visible thesaurus browser, hierarchy, narrower-term navigation, explosion setting, or expansion control.
controlled_vocabulary.official_documentation: The Advanced Search documentation identifies INDEXTERMS as an indexing-term field; the inspected current documentation does not establish a Scopus-wide hierarchy, scope notes, or explosion semantics for this search.
controlled_vocabulary.conclusion: No usable Scopus-wide thesaurus hierarchy/explosion route is established. No descriptor meets the source-supported scope/hierarchy prerequisite, so no OR-supplement descriptor test is authorized or performed. Free-text TITLE-ABS-KEY blocks remain mandatory. A generic systems-engineering indexed heading cannot alone satisfy M_H.

other_reconciled_semantics.source_boundary: Scopus is retained as its own bibliographic-database source through the normal rendered Advanced Documents Search route; do not conflate it with another source or history total.
other_reconciled_semantics.date_and_language: P01 observed PUBYEAR and LANGUAGE syntax only. P-001 has not set the common cutoff; no final date control is accepted. Metadata-language syntax is not proof of full-report English, so language remains a screening rule unless later validation supports a native limit.
other_reconciled_semantics.ordering_and_pagination: P01 observed Date (newest) default and visible sort/page-size controls. P08 repeated an A2 two-page ordered identity sequence, validating the bounded rendered pagination route.
other_reconciled_semantics.stable_identity: The adapter-normalized Scopus publication identity plus its canonical publication path is the current capture identity; P08 demonstrated ordered repeat hashes and P09 used the same identity in the BT2 union. Final events still require two complete passes and reconciliation.
other_reconciled_semantics.capture_method: The validated rendered adapter capture route is selected. The protocol requires complete pagination or an equivalent capture plus identity/completeness reconciliation, not a native file export. Therefore native export is not an acceptance blocker; P01's observed export-menu options and untested export caps remain historical interface facts only.
other_reconciled_semantics.source_limit_and_failure: P09's one broad count-only diagnostic failed closed at result_reconciliation with total=null, zero records, and no prefix. Any cap or reconciliation failure remains null rather than zero.
